components.html: Stakeholder

narrative.overview: PAKAR extends this incumbent system in Operate mode: IBM Plex Sans, neutral flat surfaces, square controls, blue actions and hairline-separated review rows. It does not replace the marketing identity. Its task headings use weight 400; compact metadata and source trails sit below the heading/body hierarchy. Repeated 13px metadata is observed density, not a new default body token.

rules.name: The Inspect Before Commitment Rule
rules.body: Keep review controls beside the assumptions they approve. Claims expose source excerpts, numerical values and units; persona disclosures expose goals, motivations, constraints, knowledge, interests, proposed relationships and provenance before approval. Source-supported attributes do not establish synthetic behavior as fact.

rules.name: The Conditional Results Rule
rules.body: Finding priority has a text label and is explicitly separate from probability. Findings retain uncertainty, origin, evidence gaps and a next validation task. Calculations retain conditional labels and unknown values. Blue informational notices and semantic green/yellow/red status tints supplement readable labels; these tints are functional states, not additional brand accents.

rules.name: The Same Inspection Rule
rules.body: Desktop graph nodes support Enter/Space with visible focus; the stakeholder selector exposes the same relationship details on mobile, where the SVG is hidden below 560px. Keep profile provenance and causal-event controls available in both presentations. New scenario findings and shared findings retain disclosures and links to the preserved baseline, rather than reducing comparison to a count.

rules.name: The Stable Portrait Rule
rules.body: A saved identity keeps one locally generated portrait across lists, graph nodes, details, reports, timelines and scenarios. Human stakeholders use Personas; analytical/system agents use Fun Emoji. Stable IDs take precedence over editable metadata. Keep the pinned DiceBear versions and generator options stable; changing either requires an explicit avatar-version migration.
